blocks.html: Carlstadt makes the most of its location. blocks.title: Bolera Snort Brewery
blocks.html: At 316 20th Street, Bolero Snort has been crafting hoof-inspired ales and lagers in Carlstadt since 2013, opening its own production facility and tasting room in 2020 after years of contract brewing across the tristate area. The taproom pours a rotating selection of classic and experimental styles, from crisp lagers to bold IPAs and creative sour ales, with a beer garden, food truck partnerships, and private event space rounding out the experience. Its location just a short walk from MetLife Stadium, has made it a natural gathering spot for pre- and post-event crowds.

blocks.title: Carlstadt Historical Society Firehouse Museum
blocks.html: Housed in the borough's 1919 firehouse at Division and Sixth, the Carlstadt Historical Society museum preserves the community's story across two floors of exhibits. The ground floor covers WWI and WWII memorabilia from local residents, police and fire department artifacts, and a collection of bottles manufactured by Carlstadt's once-thriving glass industry. The upper floor is dedicated to the borough's school history, with class photos, graduation pennants from what is recognized as the oldest continuous school picnic in the United States, and donated items from former businesses that once lined the town's streets.

blocks.title: River Barge Park
blocks.html: River Barge Park is a 5.5-acre waterfront park on the Hackensack River managed by the New Jersey Sports and Exposition Authority. The park offers a boat ramp, paddling and fishing dock, a scenic promenade lined with native plantings, picnic tables, and catch-and-release fishing. The site has a layered history, having served as a WWII seaplane training base in the 1940s before becoming a popular local restaurant, known as the Barge Club, in the ‘70s and ‘80s. Nautical artifacts from that era are displayed throughout the park today.

blocks.title: Redd's Restaurant & Biergarten
blocks.html: Redd's at 317 Washington Avenue is a casual bar and restaurant with an outdoor biergarten built around long communal tables, an extensive global beer selection, and 35-plus flat screens for sports viewing. The venue serves as a natural hub on event days at nearby MetLife Stadium, offering shuttle service to and from the complex for major events. A second-level banquet facility accommodates private gatherings from 30 to 200 guests, making it one of the more versatile event spaces in the area.

blocks.title: La Fortaleza
blocks.html: La Fortaleza brings authentic Mexican cuisine to Carlstadt as part of a multi-location operation spanning several communities across New Jersey and New York. The menu centers on traditional recipes and fresh ingredients, with tacos, enchiladas, burritos, and margaritas anchoring a lineup that has earned La Fortaleza a loyal following across the region. The Carlstadt location brings that same commitment to flavor and authenticity to the heart of the borough.

blocks.title: Il Villaggio
blocks.html: Il Villaggio at 651 Route 17 North has been serving traditional Italian cuisine in Carlstadt for nearly four decades, earning a reputation as one of the most authentic Italian dining experiences in the region. Professional chefs work exclusively with fresh ingredients, rotating daily specials alongside a full menu of classic dishes prepared with consistency and care. An intimate yet spacious dining room and a dedicated banquet operation make it equally suited to a quiet dinner and a large private celebration.

items.q: How old do you have to be to place a cannabis delivery order?

items.q: What are the per-order purchase limits for cannabis delivery in Carlstadt?
items.a_html:
New Jersey sets the per-transaction limit at the equivalent of one ounce, or 28.35 grams, of usable cannabis. Here's how that breaks down by product type:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What will the taxes be on my Carlstadt cannabis delivery order?
items.a_html: Three charges apply to adult-use cannabis in New Jersey: a 6.625% state sales tax, a $2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF), and a 2% municipal transfer or user tax, where the local municipality has authorized it. Every charge is itemized at checkout before you confirm, so there are no surprises.
